card.line: The Mount of Olives is a ridge east of Jerusalem where David wept, Jesus prayed and rode toward the city, and the LORD will one day stand.

moments.title: David weeps and climbs
moments.text: David climbed the Mount of Olives weeping, with his head covered and his feet bare. All the people with him covered their heads and wept too.

moments.title: The LORD will stand here
moments.text: Zechariah says that on that day the LORD's feet will stand on the Mount of Olives, east of Jerusalem. The mountain will split in two, forming a great valley.

moments.title: Jesus sends for a donkey
moments.text: Near Jerusalem, at the Mount of Olives, Jesus sent two disciples to bring a colt. As He rode, the crowd praised God for the miracles they had seen, and called Him the King who comes in the Lord's name.

moments.title: A hymn, then the mountain
moments.text: After the Last Supper, Jesus and His disciples sang a hymn and went out to the Mount of Olives. There Jesus said they would all fall away, and Peter said he never would.

moments.title: Jesus prays on the mountain
moments.text: Jesus went to the Mount of Olives as usual. He knelt and prayed, "Not My will, but Yours be done," and an angel strengthened Him.
